en.title: F
en.summary: The letter F is the sixth letter of the Romanian alphabet.

sections.title: The letter sound
paragraphs: This letter is called /f/. Its main sound is the sound /f/, heard in (floare) /flo̯a.re/, which means flower. The letter makes only one sound in Romanian.

sections.title: Pronouncing the letter
paragraphs: Touch your lower lip gently against your upper teeth. Blow air smoothly through the narrow gap without using your voice. Place a hand on your throat to check that your vocal cords do not buzz.

sections.title: Reading the letter
paragraphs: This letter always makes the sound /f/ in all regular positions. You can hear it at the start of (foc) /fok/.

sections.title: Tips for learners
paragraphs: This sound is identical to the first sound in the English word fish. There is no real pitfall for this letter.
